parsed_json.up: Select all IC50 activity rows in nM for human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then assays on assay_id, then target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target name 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50' and standard_units 'nM'. Left join docs on assays.doc_id to get pubmed_id and doi. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Inner join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno to get canonical_smiles. Return columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_records.compound_key, COALESCE(docs.pubmed_id, docs.doi) as pubmed_id_or_doi, assays.description as assay_description, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_relation, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units, activities.activity_comment, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, target_dictionary.organism as target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
